title: Chapter 1332 - 14: To See Me Is To See The Azure Heavens
content:
Chapter 1332 - 14: To See Me Is To See The Azure Heavens

Chapter 1332: Chapter 14: To See Me Is to See the Azure Heavens

Up to now, there are a total of seven Thirteen-tier beings of time in the Chaos Void.

Adding the one who is about to break through the time loop now, there would be eight beings of time.

"To think, this Luo Hou Great Saint can break through the time loop, is it because of me?" Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The life now about to break through the time loop is precisely Luo Hou Great Saint.

Earlier, Lin Yuan had already noticed the trend of Luo Hou Great Saint breaking through the time loop.

It was through the perception of the lord’s status that this conclusion was reached, something other beings of time could not do.

And the reason Luo Hou Great Saint could so smoothly break through the time loop is related to witnessing Lin Yuan’s terrifying strength.

It is precisely because of this.

Luo Hou Great Saint put aside the idea of proving the ’invincible name’, which led to a shift in his mindset and the dissipation of obsession.

Of course.

Breaking through the time loop is influenced by obsession, but obsession is not everything.

The main focus is on whether one can pass the final test within the loop.

...

At the moment of the tremor in the time loop area.

The seven beings of time in the Chaos Void also sensed it.

"Is this... another time being born in our Chaos Void?"

"Hahaha, this is a good thing, I originally thought it would be the Galaxy."

Smiles appeared on the faces of the seven time beings, as time beings in the same Chaos Void, they would naturally form ally relations once the great destruction leads them into dimensional gaps.

The more naturally the better.

Lord Mo Xu and the other seven time beings left their own legacies with the thought of nurturing new Thirteen-tiers.

"The newly born time being is named ’Luo Hou’? I had observed him before, the probability of breaking through the time loop was low, I didn’t expect he really broke through in the end."

Lord Mo Xu spoke with emotion, regularly awakening to take a look, while also keeping an eye on whether there were any extraordinary Great Saints in the Chaos Void.

He had paid attention to Luo Hou Great Saint, but at that time, Luo Hou Great Saint was unremarkable and had a low probability of breaking through the time loop in the future.

Theoretically, every being has the potential to break through the time loop, but since the Chaos Void’s inception, only Lord Mo Xu and the other seven managed to break through the time loop successfully.

"A new Thirteen-tier born at this moment is beneficial for our upcoming competition with the Taixu Dimension."

A time being with a human head and snake body said.

In the Milky Way dimension, the Heart of the Heavenly River is about to be nurtured, and the time beings of the Taixu Dimension had long arrived, forming a standoff with the seven time beings of the Chaos Void.

Both sides were tense, constantly observing the future timeline to increase their chances of winning the Heart of the Heavenly River.

At this time, even the birth of a newly ascended time being in the Chaos Void is a certain help for the Chaos Void.

At least it could ease the pressure on Lord Mo Xu and the seven time beings, as the nine time beings of the Taixu Dimension should not be underestimated.

"Indeed."

Lord Mo Xu nodded.

Originally, it was the seven time beings of the Chaos Void against the nine time beings of the Taixu Dimension.

Now it is eight versus nine.

The gap is further narrowed.

"There is a time being in the Taixu Dimension who needs the Heart of the Heavenly River to refine and repair the flesh, which is why they have sought to seize the Heart of the Heavenly River."

Lord Mo Xu thought to himself.

Over the years, they had also figured out the real reason why the Taixu Dimension sought the Heart of the Heavenly River.

The Heart of the Heavenly River, besides refining to sense the fluctuations of the Rule of Time in the Milky Way dimension.

It is essentially a unique treasure capable of refining the body, particularly benefiting those time beings following the water attribute path.

The time being from the Taixu Dimension developed an irreversible flaw in his bodily cultivation, urgently needed a unique treasure like the Heart of the Heavenly River to refine, so he set his target on the Milky Way dimension.

...

As the time loop rapidly collapsed.

A figure swiftly walked out from it.

"How many events have happened since time immemorial, turning everything into nothing but emptiness."

’Luo Hou’ appeared at the highest point of the Chaos Void, overlooking countless beings, with a hint of joy on his face, "I, Luo Hou, have finally broken through the time loop."

At this moment, ’Luo Hou’ was filled with emotion, having not held much hope before advancing to the Thirteen-tier.

How many invincible Great Saints have existed throughout time? How many ultimately became time beings?

Even with the strength of an invincible Great Saint, he never swept the Chaos Void, unlike the invincible Great Saints of history, and had no possibility of becoming a time being.

But at that moment, Luo Hou had reached the extreme, mastering that Thirteen-tier legacy, which was already the limit, and could only proceed to break through to the Thirteen-tier.

Sigh.

After breaking through the time loop, the essence of Luo Hou’s life began to transform rapidly, simultaneously taking a breath.

Instantly.

The entire Chaos Void began to shake.

The Primordial Lands fully opened, with boundless Chaos Void Origin pouring down upon Luo Hou.

Since understanding the Rule of Time, each breakthrough brings about a Chaos Void Origin Infusion.

This was true from the Eleventh-tier to the Twelfth-tier and from the Twelfth-tier to the Thirteen-tier as well.

Especially the latter, marking the transformation towards a time being, with a small half of the Chaos Void’s origins pouring forth.

"What is this?"

"This phenomenon is the sign of stepping into the Thirteen-tier time being."

"Such a scale of Chaos Void Origin Infusion only appears when becoming a time being."

The Chaos Great Saints and unparalleled Great Saints watched this scene in shock.

If each era doesn’t give birth to an Invincible Great Saint, then what about Time Life?

It’s even rarer to the extreme.

Since the Chaos Void was born, tens of thousands of Invincible Great Saints have appeared.

But Time Life?

Only seven.

Many Great Saints live their entire lives without seeing an Invincible Great Saint, let alone Time Life? Not to mention newly born Time Life, even those already born Time Life remain unseen.

"Who has become Time Life? The Galaxy Great Saint?"

Some Great Saints couldn’t help but speculate.

The Galaxy Great Saint is the Invincible Great Saint of this era and the most likely to step into the thirteenth layer.

"It’s not the Galaxy Great Saint, I have a causal connection with the Galaxy Great Saint, the one currently transforming into Time Life is not the Galaxy Great Saint."

One Great Saint spoke up, having visited the Galaxy Chaos Continent and met Lin Yuan, forming a causal link, confirming the being stepping into the thirteenth layer is not Lin Yuan.

"If it’s not the Galaxy Great Saint, then it must be some hidden old fellow."

"That must be it."

"No one knows when the Galaxy Great Saint will step into the thirteenth layer."

"Hehe, although the Galaxy Great Saint is strong, whether he can become Time Life is uncertain."

"Indeed, even the strongest Invincible Great Saint in history, so what? Did the previous strongest Invincible Great Saint become Time Life?"

The Great Saints intensely debated, ever since Lin Yuan’s abrupt emergence overshadowed all Great Saints of his age, and now with the birth of new Time Life, these Great Saints have begun comparing once again.

Isn’t your Galaxy said to be the strongest Invincible Great Saint of history?

Yet, can you ultimately step into the thirteenth layer like this Great Saint and become Time Life?

If you don’t become Time Life, no matter how strong the power is, it’s false, plunging eternally into the time cycle.

...

"Is this what Time Life is?"

The newly-instated thirteenth layer Luo Hou felt his power frantically enhancing with a small half of Chaos Void Origin Infusion, every moment his strength soared.

When life essence elevated to a certain height, Luo Hou bow his head to gaze, faintly lines of time stretched and spread.

"Still somewhat unfamiliar."

Luo Hou found slight difficulty in watching the time lines, unsurprisingly, being new Time Life, even the strength isn’t fully grasped, watching future time lines? Naturally unfamiliar.

Like a newborn baby unable to walk or run, even though walking and running are instinctual, being newly born, with strength yet to grow, how to walk.

Luo Hou at this moment was much the same, observing time lines for Time Life is instinctual, but instinct also needs gradual familiarization.

After a long time.

The Chaos Void Origin Infusion gradually ended.

Luo Hou didn’t retreat immediately to digest the accumulated origin within him, instead his mind slightly moved, looking down towards various places in the Chaos Void.

"Galaxy Great Saint..."

Luo Hou felt an unprecedentedly strong urge to meet the Galaxy Great Saint.

It wasn’t due to any ill will or desire for revenge, but purely for the sake of meeting.

At this moment, Luo Hou also realized that being able to smoothly break through the time cycle was related to the Galaxy Great Saint.

If it weren’t for the Galaxy Great Saint’s intervention, shattering his obsession with proving "invincible name," he wouldn’t have survived the final pass in the time cycle.

If he couldn’t make it through, the longer time dragged on, the lesser chance of breaking through the time cycle.

"Now I am Time Life, even newly instated, I wouldn’t fear a mere twelfth layer life."

Luo Hou was very confident, as new Time Life, despite his strength still unstable and his time line observation stumbling.

But Time Life is Time Life, even a fraction of the quintillion strength can crush Invincible Great Saints, this is the difference in life essence.

"There..."

After stepping into the thirteenth layer, Luo Hou’s understanding of the causal avenue deepened, rapidly locating the Galaxy Great Saint’s position through their cause.

Of course, this was also due to Lin Yuan not intentionally concealing his cause.

Whoosh!

The next moment.

Luo Hou’s figure disappeared.

Appearing in a piece of Desolate Void.

"Galaxy..."

Luo Hou looked forward.

Only to see Lin Yuan with hands folded behind, standing in the void smiling at him, seemingly well-prepared for his arrival.

This startled Luo Hou, directly facing Lin Yuan, sensing the vast power within this Galaxy Great Saint, even he as Time Life couldn’t compare to the vastness.

Moreover, Luo Hou instinctively tried observing Lin Yuan’s future time line, but found it wasn’t stumbling, but utterly obscure and empty.

"Luo Hou, congratulations on becoming Time Life."

Lin Yuan smiled looking at Luo Hou.

"You..."

Luo Hou actually felt a bit fearful, he could ascertain Lin Yuan wasn’t Time Life.

But not being Time Life, how could he be so strong?

"No need for comparison between you and me."

Lin Yuan glanced at Luo Hou.

If you don’t become Time Life, you’d only feel I’m slightly stronger Invincible Great Saint, seeing me like looking up at the moon.

If you become Time Life, you’ll see me as witnessing the blue sky.
